name: qfd_vm_bctl_t
slot_change_request: el1011-qwen-tp8.log 2026-10-13 PLAN: VM SLOT CHANGE REQUEST v2 (bit-plane VM, die-assembled leaves: regions of bank / SU / FIFO leaves with per-consumer control leaves, one row of 32 xcol leaves in the band, relay strips)

job.purpose: Qwen TP8 VM bank control leaf (8 per region, 64 per die): reset relay, me / pop replica, the bank's control + address + mask pin flops and NRI relays, x tag chain, FIFO gate; 78 flops, one root. Replaces the per-bank part of gctl_t (region seams <= 300 um, no added edge). Bench = region-leaf miter vs the flat ot_qfd_vm_region_quarter + the three bctl mutants. Second cut: M5 PG stripes at 2.7 um (the first route closed TT/FF/DRC but its view failed child_lint (b): two stripes per net spanned 42 % of the narrow tile).
